captures.description: THE NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The term eclipse archive can refer to several distinct topics depending on the context:' Five bullets: 'Poetry & Digital Archives: The Eclipse Archive is a digital poetry publisher and archive founded by Craig Dworkin and edited by Danny Snelson, featuring out-of-print and avant-garde writing (such as Gnome Baker magazine)'; the Eclipse Foundation's project archives; 'Eclipse Archives', a streetwear brand of anime drops; NASA's Historical Eclipse Image Archive; Eclipse IDE archive tools. Eight cards: eclipsearchive.org, the brand's shop, NASA, the Eclipse Foundation (two), the Eclipse Marketplace (two), TikTok.
